about.title: [ ABOUT: NOTRACER ]
about.problem_text: Invisible commercial surveillance is the default state of the internet. Every time you copy a link, you are likely carrying digital fingerprints—hidden parameters like utm_source, fbclid, and gclid. These microscopic trackers are engineered by corporations to map your movements, profile your behavior, and auction your attention across the web.
about.solution_text: We strip them away. NoTracer was constructed as a direct, hostile response to the monetization of metadata. We intercept contaminated URLs, run them through a rigorous deep-clean engine, and return them sanitized.
about.philosophy_subtitle: We do not care who you are, where you are, or what you share. Our technical commitment is absolute:
about.philosophy_footer: The sanitization process is strictly volatile. Original contaminated URLs are never permanently stored except as ephemeral pointers in Redis. Cache data is automatically incinerated.
about.status_text: This platform serves as an open engineering initiative dedicated to building a cleaner, more ethical web infrastructure.
about.slogan: // SHARE THE CONTENT, NOT YOUR DATA.

faq.title: [ FAQ / PROTOCOLS ]
faq.a1: We strip commercial tracking strings (like utm_campaign, fbclid, gclid) from URLs without breaking the core destination. The link takes you exactly where you want to go, just without the digital fingerprints attached.
faq.a2: Because a cleaner internet belongs to everyone. This is a community-driven, open beta engineering project. We believe you should share the content, not your data, and nobody should pay a premium for basic privacy.
faq.q3: How do I know you aren't tracking my clicks?
faq.a3: Our architecture is built on a Zero-Knowledge philosophy. We use SvelteKit and a volatile Redis cache with aggressive TTL (Time to Live) limits. Metadata is incinerated automatically. There are no databases storing your browsing history.
faq.q4: Is it safe for banking or private links?
faq.a4: We only sanitize public URL metadata. NoTracer never touches encrypted content, credentials, or secure payloads. However, as an active beta, we recommend using it primarily for sanitizing social media and e-commerce links.
faq.q5: What is the future of this Beta?
faq.a5: Aggressive tracking scripts from platforms like TikTok or Instagram evolve daily. We will continually update our Deep-Clean Engine patterns to counter new surveillance techniques, ensuring your links remain pristine.

landing.subtitle: // Share the content. Not your data. Not your location. Not your identity.
landing.m1_desc: Cleans tracking parasites from URLs. Eliminates UTM, fbclid, gclid and over 200 digital fingerprint vectors before sharing.
landing.m2_desc: Converts PNG/JPG to WebP silently. Removes EXIF metadata containing GPS coordinates, device info, and timestamps.
landing.m3_desc: Send files and messages that self-destruct after reading. Zero-knowledge encryption, no accounts needed.
landing.m4_desc: Generates QR codes routed through privacy relays. Hides the destination from scanners and analytics platforms.
landing.about_p1: NoTracer was built as a direct and hostile response to the monetization of metadata. Invisible commercial surveillance is the default state of the internet — we are building the antidote, tool by tool.
landing.about_p2: Every link you share carries digital fingerprints. We eliminate them all. No logs. No analytics. No trace.
landing.support_p1: NoTracer is a project dedicated to technical privacy. If this tool helps keep you hidden, share it with others who value their digital sovereignty.
